title: WeddingRsvp
description: One guest's answer for one event of a wedding (issue #29). Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, `${event_id}:${guest_id}`). No record means the default: the event's invitation (a plus-one follows their host), pending. Removed with its guest or its event.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

event_id.description: An event of the same wedding.

guest_id.description: A guest (wedding_guest) of the same wedding.

invited.description: Whether the guest is invited to this event (overrides the event's invitation default). A guest not invited has no answer (status pending).

meal_option_id.description: One of the event's meal options; only while attending.

answered_by.description: Who recorded the current answer: the planner or the couple in the console, or the household on its RSVP page (issue #30).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, from the injected clock.
